generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Sample from a small pool of realistic short strings; 10% near-variants (case/whitespace/typo) of pool values; never NULL unless column nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_name: Sample from a pool of realistic names; 15% near-variants; allow duplicates on DISTINCT-targeted columns.
generic_sampling_rules.int_positive: Uniform integer in [1, 1000]; 10% boundary values at listed literals +/-1.
generic_sampling_rules.real_amount: Uniform real in [0.0, 20.0] rounded to 2 decimals; boundary at 8.49/8.5/8.51/8.99/9/9.01/9.99/10/10.01.
generic_sampling_rules.real_percent: Uniform real in [0.0, 5.0] rounded to 1 decimal.
generic_sampling_rules.text_percent: Numeric string with one decimal, value in [0.0, 300.0].
generic_sampling_rules.nullable: Each nullable column: NULL share per column taken from the compact database's observed share (fallback 0.05 when the compact share is 0), at least one NULL row and at least one non-NULL row per instance.
generic_sampling_rules.pk_int: Sequential integers starting at max(compact PK)+1 so generated rows never collide with preserved compact rows.
generic_sampling_rules.pk_text: Sequential integers rendered as text starting at max(compact PK)+1 so generated rows never collide with preserved compact rows.
